# INTRX — The Interaction Library

> A curated, copy-paste library of the web interactions used by award-winning
> design agencies. 399 native patterns are implemented, including the full 52-entry DRAMS collection.
> Each pattern ships three things: a live demo, a single-file HTML+CSS+JS
> snippet, and an LLM prompt that specifies the interaction precisely enough
> to rebuild it in any framework.

Site: https://intrx.vercel.app
Registry: https://intrx.vercel.app/registry/index.json
License: MIT; photographs under the Unsplash License with per-component attribution. DRAMS by 1042 Studio (@mrblackstudio and @karimeshrimp).

## Interface

- [Elastic Edges](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/slider-elastic-edges): drag · Five bounded photo slides preserve rubber-band resistance and velocity prediction through fitted dragging. · registry: /registry/c/slider-elastic-edges.json
- [Fraction Slider](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/slider-progress-fraction): press · A five-frame photo sequence with shared segment navigation and an animated fraction. · registry: /registry/c/slider-progress-fraction.json
- [Clip Transition](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/slider-clip-transition): press · Four photographs reveal from the point you press; new input retargets the live circular mask. · registry: /registry/c/slider-clip-transition.json
- [Stack Deck](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/slider-stack-deck): drag · A five-card photo queue with fitted dragging, velocity decisions and continuous recycling. · registry: /registry/c/slider-stack-deck.json
- [Parallax Slides](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/slider-fullbleed-parallax): press · Four photo slides travel with slower inner media, native keys and pointer parallax. · registry: /registry/c/slider-fullbleed-parallax.json
- [Filmstrip Scrub](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/gallery-filmstrip-scrub): hover · An eight-frame cursor scrubber keeps direct normalized selection, complete timecodes and a visited history. · registry: /registry/c/gallery-filmstrip-scrub.json
- [Expanding Columns](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/gallery-expanding-columns): hover · Five photo columns redistribute space through measured FLIP transitions and native focus or touch. · registry: /registry/c/gallery-expanding-columns.json
- [Honeycomb](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/gallery-honeycomb): hover · Fourteen hexagonal cells find their nearest neighbors from measured centers, with a native seven-cell preview. · registry: /registry/c/gallery-honeycomb.json
- [Print Pile](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/gallery-random-stack): press · Seven seeded contact prints land in a complete recycling pile with deterministic positions and rotations. · registry: /registry/c/gallery-random-stack.json
- [Dual Row Drift](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/gallery-dual-row-drift): hover · Twenty-four photographs form two seamless opposing rows that pause and straighten under hover or focus. · registry: /registry/c/gallery-dual-row-drift.json
- [Lightbox Zoom](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/lightbox-flip-zoom): press · Six local photographs expand from their measured thumbnail rectangles and return focus on close. · registry: /registry/c/lightbox-flip-zoom.json
- [3D Wheel](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/slider-wheel-3d): drag · Nine named projects share wrapped cylinder positions, wheel and fitted pointer input with velocity-aware release. · registry: /registry/c/slider-wheel-3d.json
- [Snap Carousel](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scrollsnap-carousel): scroll · Five native scroll-snap cards center at every endpoint with distance-driven emphasis and switchable snap modes. · registry: /registry/c/scrollsnap-carousel.json
- [Fullscreen Menu](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/menu-fullscreen-overlay): press · A local fullscreen menu reveals five studio routes, owns focus while open and returns to its native opener after selection or dismissal. · registry: /registry/c/menu-fullscreen-overlay.json
- [Split Reveal Menu](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/menu-split-reveal): press · Opposing page halves move away from a center seam to expose four native routes, then close after selection or Escape. · registry: /registry/c/menu-split-reveal.json
- [Circular Menu](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/menu-circular-expand): press · A measured circular clip grows from the menu button to reveal four routes and contracts from its current position when interrupted. · registry: /registry/c/menu-circular-expand.json
- [Blur-Elevate Nav](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/nav-blur-elevate): scroll · A sticky navigation surface frosts and compresses when the local article crosses its 72px threshold. · registry: /registry/c/nav-blur-elevate.json
- [Hide-Reveal Nav](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/nav-hide-reveal): scroll · A direction-aware sticky bar moves with local scroll deltas, hides downward and returns on an upward reversal. · registry: /registry/c/nav-hide-reveal.json
- [Active Pill Nav](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/nav-active-pill): press · A single measured pill follows native link selection, stretching between its current rectangle and the next target without blocking rapid changes. · registry: /registry/c/nav-active-pill.json
- [Letter Cascade](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/menu-letter-cascade): hover · Letters roll through individual masks while pointer, focus and press share one selected route; sibling links dim only during intentional interaction. · registry: /registry/c/menu-letter-cascade.json
- [Image Peek List](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/menu-image-peek): hover · Each project selects a real photograph; the bounded preview follows a fine pointer and returns to its resting position without keeping a frame loop alive. · registry: /registry/c/menu-image-peek.json
- [Collapsing Breadcrumb](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/breadcrumb-collapse): press · Three intermediate routes unfold from a native ellipsis control while the first and current destinations stay in reading order. · registry: /registry/c/breadcrumb-collapse.json

- [Border Beam](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/btn-border-beam): ambient · A narrow light follows the edge of a charcoal Deploy button. Pause and resume the perimeter loop, or press the button for a quiet squash and release. · registry: /registry/c/btn-border-beam.json

- [Text Slide Swap](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/btn-text-slide-swap): hover · The archive label rises while its twin arrives from below. Pointer, keyboard and touch intent share an interruptible transition. · registry: /registry/c/btn-text-slide-swap.json
- [Icon Hop](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/btn-icon-hop): hover · An arrow hops inside an orange socket while the project button has pointer or keyboard intent. Touch activation plays one complete hop. · registry: /registry/c/btn-icon-hop.json
- [Success Morph](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/btn-success-morph): press · A publish action contracts into a loading control, then resolves into a compact green confirmation. Replay safely interrupts either phase and restores the ready state. · registry: /registry/c/btn-success-morph.json
- [Confetti Burst](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/btn-confetti-burst): press · A compact milestone action fans out a seeded celebration. Independent bursts share one clock; clear cancels the field, and reduced motion shows a quiet still confirmation. · registry: /registry/c/btn-confetti-burst.json
- [Ripple](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/btn-ripple-material): press · A soft radial wave starts at the exact press point and reaches the farthest corner. Overlapping presses remain independent; keyboard activation starts at the center. · registry: /registry/c/btn-ripple-material.json
- [Jelly Press](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/btn-jelly-press): press · The soft white button stays compressed while held, then returns through a small spring rebound. Pointer cancellation, keyboard release and replay all resolve safely. · registry: /registry/c/btn-jelly-press.json
- [Like Burst](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/like-heart-particles): press · A like pops the heart, sends eight subtle dots outward and changes the final digit. Unliking cancels the burst and returns the count quietly. · registry: /registry/c/like-heart-particles.json
- [Checkbox Draw](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/checkbox-draw-check): press · Three native checkboxes pair a quiet fill with a check reveal. The first two are selected in the thumbnail; labels and Space-key input remain authoritative. · registry: /registry/c/checkbox-draw-check.json
- [Theme Switch](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/toggle-day-night): press · Choose Light, Dark or Auto with a sliding indicator. Auto follows the operating system and emits the effective preference without changing the library shell. · registry: /registry/c/toggle-day-night.json
- [Copy Feedback](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/copy-inline-feedback): press · A compact copy action acknowledges success in place and returns to its ready label. - [Spring Tooltip](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/hover-tooltip-spring): hover · The tooltip opens from its current toolbar anchor, travels between neighbors and follows the pointer with a small lag. - [Badge Pop](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/badge-notification-pop): ambient · The notification badge pops as new messages arrive. Rapid additions queue from the committed count; pause and reset stay available in the shared dock. · registry: /registry/c/badge-notification-pop.json
- [Polish Stages](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/btn-polish-stages): press · Choose Fill, Border, Light or Depth to add one layer of polish to a persistent button. The final layer demonstrates hover and press before returning to Fill. · registry: /registry/c/btn-polish-stages.json
- [Floating Label](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/input-float-label): type · The email label resolves into the border on focus and stays raised while a value is present. Clearing an unfocused field restores the resting label. · registry: /registry/c/input-float-label.json
- [Underline Grow](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/input-underline-grow): type · The underline opens from the pointer entry point, or from the center for keyboard focus. Focus and blur reverse the same transition without resetting the value. · registry: /registry/c/input-underline-grow.json
- [Shake Error](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/input-shake-error): press · An incomplete email gets a short local shake and a specific domain hint. Correction clears the error; reset cancels pending emphasis and repeated submissions restart cleanly. · registry: /registry/c/input-shake-error.json

## Motion

- [Smooth Scroll](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/lenis-smooth-scroll): scroll · Four editorial sections scroll with wheel momentum and a gentle landing. Native touch and keyboard scrolling remain available. · registry: /registry/c/lenis-smooth-scroll.json
- [Stagger Reveal](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-reveal-stagger): scroll · Six cards rise and resolve in reading order when their group enters the scroll viewport. Scrolling away resets the reveal. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-reveal-stagger.json
- [Parallax Layers](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/parallax-layers): scroll · Layers move at different speeds relative to scroll, faking depth. Background drifts slowly, foreground overtakes — a two-line transform with outsized effect. · registry: /registry/c/parallax-layers.json
- [Horizontal Scroll](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/horizontal-scroll): scroll · Vertical scrolling pins the section and drives a horizontal track — the signature gallery pattern of portfolio and case-study sites. · registry: /registry/c/horizontal-scroll.json
- [Sticky Stack](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/sticky-stack): scroll · Cards pin on top of each other while scrolling; each incoming card slightly scales down the one beneath it. Pure CSS sticky with a pinch of JS. · registry: /registry/c/sticky-stack.json
- [Reading Progress](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-progress): scroll · A hairline bar that fills as you scroll, plus a live percentage readout. Small detail, strong "crafted" signal. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-progress.json
- [Velocity Skew](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/velocity-skew): scroll · Content skews proportionally to scroll speed and eases back when you stop — the page feels like it has physical drag. A Locomotive Scroll signature. · registry: /registry/c/velocity-skew.json
- [Scroll Zoom](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-zoom): scroll · A pinned media block scales from an inset thumbnail to full-bleed as you scroll through the section — the cinematic "expand into the story" transition. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-zoom.json
- [Text Highlight](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-text-highlight): scroll · A long-form passage measures its own native scroll range and continuously fills each word from dim ink to bright paper-white, turning reading position into an exact sequential typographic signal. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-text-highlight.json
- [Image Sequence](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-image-sequence): scroll · A product-style canvas scene advances through 48 discrete, procedurally rendered frames as the local scroll position changes. The result has the precise, authored cadence of an image sequence without downloading a video or sprite sheet. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-image-sequence.json
- [Route Draw](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-svg-draw): scroll · An editorial route diagram draws itself segment by segment as the local page scrolls. Every dash length is measured from the real SVG geometry, so the reveal remains exact when the paths change. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-svg-draw.json
- [Rotating Gallery](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-rotate-gallery): scroll · Seven editorial cards travel around a circular fan as the local panel scrolls. The card nearest the focus axis is selected from angular distance, then raised, sharpened, and scaled without relying on hard-coded active ranges. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-rotate-gallery.json
- [Split Screen](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-split-screen): scroll · Four narrative chapters scroll on the right while a pinned visual field on the left crossfades continuously between their paired scenes. The transition is derived from chapter progress, so copy, imagery, navigation, and accessibility remain in lockstep. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-split-screen.json
- [Crossing Marquees](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-marquee-direction): scroll · Three continuous type bands reverse when scroll direction changes, accelerate from measured scroll velocity, and lean into the impulse before settling upright. Direction persists; velocity decays independently. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-marquee-direction.json
- [Counter-Rotating Rings](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-counter-rotate): scroll · Two overlapping circular text paths rotate in opposite directions at different scroll ratios. A fixed optical center and synchronized angular telemetry make the counter-motion legible instead of ornamental noise. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-counter-rotate.json
- [Depth Tunnel](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-depth-tunnel): scroll · Nine nested portal frames travel from a distant vanishing point through the camera on an exponential scale curve. Frames recycle after crossing the near plane, creating continuous spatial travel from a finite DOM. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-depth-tunnel.json
- [Letter Scatter](https://intrx.vercel.app/#/c/scroll-letter-scatter): scroll · A headline breaks into individually routed glyphs as its section scrolls away. Every letter follows a deterministic quadratic Bézier trajectory, keeping the composition art-directed and perfectly repeatable. · registry: /registry/c/scroll-letter-scatter.json
